$comment: ADR-1327: the v0.7 rooms arc does not serve may keep a module under face/src/modules only when a row here names the room id and ADR-1327 -- face-coverage's module half reads this file (face v2 Phase 02). The ids a row may name are derived from modules-v2.json's extra class, never listed here, so an unnamed exemption FAILs. The owner's PLAN-face-v2 section 13 item 5 ruling (2026-09-18, ADR-1337) gave story and factory registry rows; executor and agents stay here. A row is an object with an id and an adr, and the name, ring, sentence and lede the shell draws the room from -- the door serves this file (/api/file/module-exemptions), because a room the registry does not serve has no other source for them.
